name: wickchart
description: <wick-chart> — a modern, dependency-free financial charting web component. Candles, line & area charts, crosshair, zoom/pan, indicators (incl. a safe expression mini-language), live streaming via <wick-feed>, theming.

scripts.build:types: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('types', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.ci: npm run build:types && npm test && node --check src/wick-chart.js && node --check src/wick-feed.js && node --check src/core.js && node --check demo/app.js
